physicalAcceptance.limit: Sequential short field runs, not a controlled benchmark. Lower readiness/bootstrap times cannot all be attributed to the cursor-entry IPC reduction. The protocol transaction count is deterministically reduced, but long-term stability and the separate A wheel-capture failure remain unproven. Cross-PC timestamps are not subtracted; exchange tags match the paired profiles.

Investigate binding/authentication scheduling if the remaining tail is still perceptible; this data does not establish GC/STW, network RTT, or process-loading causation.
